title: cassia fitchiana
intro: Cassia fitchiana, commonly known as Senna fitchiana, is a plant species belonging to the Legume family (Fabaceae) and is native to tropical regions. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin problems. Therapeutic actions attributed to Cassia fitchiana include its purgative and laxative effects, as well as its ability to support the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
